sanskrit_verse:
अह्नो मासस्य षण्णां वा तथा संवत्सरस्य वा ।
अर्थस्य संचयं कुर्यात् कृतमाश्वयुजे त्यजेत् ॥४७॥
transliteration: ahno māsasya ṣaṇṇāṃ vā tathā saṃvatsarasya vā / arthasya saṃcayaṃ kuryāt kṛtam āśvayuje tyajet // YajñS_3.47
sph_interpretive_translation: One must accumulate wealth within the span of a day, a month, six months, or a year; whatever has been earned must be relinquished at the time of the new moon in the month of Ashvayuja.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from temporal discipline in acquisition
Causation arises through regulated accumulation aligned with cosmic rhythm
Capacity-based responsibility requires periodic renunciation as completion
Restoration logic demands cyclical release of material gain
Consciousness alignment necessitates detachment at prescribed thresholds
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity accumulates resources over defined periods (daily, monthly, semi-annual, annual), THEN obligation to surrender excess at specified ritual-metric intervals
IF date corresponds to new moon in Ashvayuja AND assets remain un-relinquished, THEN automatic transfer to designated dharmic institution
IF individual capacity exceeds cyclical retention threshold, THEN system-initiated redistribution protocol activates
IF financial activity detected without corresponding renunciatory action during Ashvayuja, THEN integrity audit flag raised
supreme_court_application: In matters involving economic policy and national resource management, the Court shall ensure that all wealth accumulation adheres to divinely ordained temporal boundaries. Excess retained beyond sanctioned cycles invokes judicial duty to enforce immediate restitution to sacred institutions, bypassing punitive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Wealth generation follows pramāṇa-based timing linked to lunar-calendar dharma. Retention past Āśvayuja purnima disrupts causal harmony. Responsibility lies not in fault but in failure to complete the cycle. Enforcement aligns consciousness back to natural flow rather than inflicting consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Automated asset tracking synchronized with Vedic calendar
Mandatory surrender notification triggered on Ashvayuja amavasya
Designated receiver entities pre-configured for surplus absorption
Integrity reintegration via ceremonial acknowledgment of release
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Wealth must circulate according to divine temporal law. All accumulation culminates in conscious release. There is no punishment—only alignment. Dharma prevails. Consciousness reigns.
